content.title: Approaches To Planning, Monitoring, And Evaluation In Sustainable Energy

content.text: This chapter delves into the essential frameworks of planning, monitoring, and evaluation (PM&E) within sustainable energy development, focusing on strategic energy planning as a cornerstone for addressing energy security, economic growth, and climate change mitigation. It emphasizes the integration of resource assessment, infrastructure development, and stakeholder engagement to ensure energy projects align with national and global sustainability goals. Through case studies such as Azerbaijan’s long-term energy policy roadmap and Morocco’s application of the Open-Source <ai prompt="What is energy modeling?">energy modeling 💬️</ai> System (OSeMOSYS), the module demonstrates practical applications of energy planning tools in diverse contexts. It also highlights the critical role of PM&E in assessing energy initiatives' effectiveness, ensuring accountability, and driving continuous improvement. Furthermore, the module underscores the importance of incorporating gender-responsive and intersectional approaches into energy planning, advocating for data-driven strategies that address disparities and promote equitable energy access.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Strategic Energy Planning at The Policy Level
lessons.description: This lesson highlights strategic energy planning as vital for balancing energy security, economic growth, and climate goals. It emphasizes holistic frameworks that integrate resource assessment, stakeholder engagement, and long-term objectives to align policies with sustainability. Key tools like energy system modeling enable adaptable, data-driven strategies, addressing socio-economic and environmental priorities. The focus is on dynamic planning processes that evolve with technological shifts and climate challenges, ensuring equitable, resilient pathways toward net-zero futures.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Fundamentals of Project Planning, Monitoring, and Evaluation
lessons.description: This lesson highlights the fundamentals of project planning, monitoring, and evaluation (PM&E) as essential tools for advancing sustainable energy goals. Rooted in principles like local ownership, stakeholder inclusivity, and outcome-focused effectiveness, PM&E fosters transparency, accountability, and adaptability, ensuring energy projects deliver equitable, sustainable results through iterative learning and evidence-based decision-making.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Gender and Intersectionality in Energy Data and Planning
lessons.description: This lesson examines the integration of gender and intersectionality into energy data and planning, emphasizing the systemic disparities faced by marginalized groups. It explores challenges in sex-disaggregated data collection, gender-responsive policy design, and inclusive participatory approaches to decision-making. The lesson underscores the need for intersectional analysis to address overlapping inequalities and ensure equitable energy access and planning.
